# ARENOVA

> Enterprise AI Automation Agency — Business Workflow Automation, Sales & Outreach Pipelines, 24/7 AI Frontdesk, and Autonomous Systems Architecture.

ARENOVA designs, builds, and deploys custom AI automation systems for modern enterprises. We automate sales pipelines, multi-channel cold outreach, internal business operations, and 24/7 customer triage — eliminating manual bottlenecks so companies scale on autopilot.

## Core Pages & Systems

- [Home & Capabilities](https://arenova.in/): Overview of Business & Workflow Automation, Sales & Outreach Automation, 24/7 AI Frontdesk Agents, interactive system demo, and free architecture audit request.
- [Pricing & Tiers](https://arenova.in/pricing/): Transparent monthly and quarterly investment packages: Sales & Outreach Engine ($999/mo), Business & Operations Automation ($1,999/mo), Autonomous Enterprise ($3,499/mo), and 24/7 AI Frontdesk add-on ($490/mo).
- [About Arenova](https://arenova.in/about/): Engineering philosophy, four architectural pillars (deterministic logic, deep integration, speed, security), technology stack, and founder background.

## Core Services

- [Business & Operations Automation](https://arenova.in/#services): End-to-end operational pipelines connecting CRMs, ERPs, Slack, Google Workspace/Microsoft 365, and billing gateways without human data entry. Document extraction AI, invoice reconciliation, and approval hierarchies.
- [Sales & Multichannel Outreach Automation](https://arenova.in/#services): Dedicated cold outreach infrastructure (15+ warmed secondary domains, SPF/DKIM/DMARC) paired with AI hyper-personalization, lead enrichment (Clay, Apollo), and automated follow-ups booking 20–40+ sales calls/month.
- [24/7 AI Front Desk & Receptionist](https://arenova.in/#services): Telephony voice and WhatsApp receptionists that answer inquiries in <15s, qualify leads, answer FAQs with zero hallucination, and book appointments directly into calendars.

## Arenova Product Ecosystem

- [Arenova Frontdesk](https://frontdesk.arenova.in): AI-powered voice & WhatsApp receptionist and calendar booking for clinics and service businesses.
- [Arova Intelligence](https://arenova.in/#ascent): B2B lead intelligence and intent detection engine (early access via architecture audit).
- [Outreacher](https://outreacher.arenova.in): Multi-channel cold sales outreach and email deliverability engine.
